purpose: Add canonical location identity and native query scope to existing global administrator booking search

floorId.validation: requires siteId and same-tenant canonical wp_floors belonging to siteId, otherwise404

privacy: Count and content use identical canonical tenant JOIN and scope WHERE before pagination. No roles,grants,PEP bundles,entitlements or write permission changes.
backwardCompatibility: Omitting both scope parameters retains existing global-admin tenant-wide search; existing legacy Java service overload preserved. Optional frontend identity fields during rollout must disable exact report-detail action when absent.
